question: Does a native Vtiger reference field (uitype 10, INT(19), fieldmodulerel to VEMSVehicles) keep the existing webservice remote-ID contract?

create_with_nonexistent_ref_37x99999.note: silently dropped to null, no error

conclusion: Remote IDs such as 37x4 are accepted and returned unchanged, so the worker, mirror guard and relationship comparisons need no change. Reference fields render as links and a related list works once setRelatedList is registered. Risk noted: a reference to a record that does not exist is silently stored as null. Null, empty and omitted references are accepted without error, which matches what the mapper sends. Limitation: updating an existing reference to an empty string does not clear it (the mapper never does this).
